unit.why: This division holds the end of R. Hayyim Lerman's approbation, a halakhic and talmudic discussion of whether one may praise tzaddikim, followed by R. Shalom Mordechai Hakohen of Brezhan's approbation letter; neither contains a narrative.
unit.boundary_note: Continues the approbation begun in the previous division; the next division begins a new paratext (the author's note on his family lineage).
